scope: Bounded static review after /tmp/primary-period-repairs.json of the seven frozen groups, protocol and named changed public implementations/tests. No candidate imports, compilation, tests, source edits, raw/archive reads or registry mutations.

findings.finding: The supposed positive calibration path fits the frequency base on rows a/b and then fits sigmoid calibration on the same rows and same fold. fit_sigmoid_calibration calls base.predict(a/b); FrequencyModel.predict calls validate_oof, which rejects those base-training sample IDs/date groups. This registered test cannot reach its positive calibration assertions.
findings.required_change: Use distinct later calibration rows/date groups and their own fold/admission, then a separate held-out prediction. Retain base training closure and calibration-stage admission forwarding; do not weaken OOF checks.

findings.finding: Admission hashes the caller-order tuple. chronological_fold validates that original order but stores digest(sorted rows), whereas model preflight and temporal compilers sort first and then validate the admission. For two valid rows supplied in reverse order, chronological_primary_fold admits and returns a fold that fit_frequency/fit_logistic reject against the same admission; temporal compilation rejects that admission immediately.
findings.required_change: Define one explicit canonical ordering for typed sample populations and use it consistently for admission construction, validation, fold hashing and model/calibration/measurement consumers, preserving legacy wire/hash behavior. Add reversed-order positive and modified/omitted-row negative cases; do not silently rebind a changed population hash.

findings.finding: The positive test registers a future endpoint B+200 with admission.actual_cut_at=B+10, then successfully finishes at B+201 using that same admission and a report containing only protocol/population hash fields. finish checks the caller-supplied finished_at against endpoint, but never establishes actual eligible observations/maturity through the endpoint. Thus the allowed planned-future endpoint becomes a completed result beyond the frozen observation cut; exact binding also rejects simply advancing the original admission cut.
findings.required_change: Keep the frozen planned protocol/binding unchanged and permit registration/begin before endpoint, but require explicit result-stage observed population/maturity and actual-cut evidence sufficient for completion. An old cut before endpoint must not certify future results merely because finished_at is later. Add a rejection that leaves the journal unchanged and a genuinely observed later completion path.

findings.finding: The seven named tests never read the frozen golden file and substitute different IDs, ranges and clocks (for example PERIOD04 seconds become nanoseconds; PERIOD05 two-day endpoint becomes B+200ns). Several mandatory frozen assertions are absent: PERIOD07 never exercises the incomplete parent universe/missing competitor; PERIOD06 only appends a missing record and does not reject the quote-dependent consumer or retained measurement closure. Frozen required_message literals are also not asserted, while the implementation emits only short error codes for the four period failures.
findings.required_change: Consume the exact frozen literal groups with only the permitted ArtifactStore reference substitutions, assert their required messages/dispositions, and exercise the missing-source and incomplete-universe public refusals. Keep additional synthetic positive variants separate within the existing case boundaries rather than replacing frozen vectors.

findings.finding: The F11 period test uses a real SemanticArtifactStore, which is good, but only constructs pre-2020 evidence and asserts rejection. It never admits an in-period primary measurement fit or serves/reopens its actual query with the same scope/policy/admission. An implementation that rejects every primary measurement request would pass this part of the registered suite.
findings.required_change: Add an in-period actual committed temporal population, real training/query read evidence and matching primary admission; admit and reopen/serve it successfully. Then change or omit the admission/population/cut at that boundary and assert failure without source/period relabelling or mocked validator success.

checked_without_additional_findings: validate_fold_population forwards scope/policy/admission to chronological_fold; validate_temporal_fold_population forwards all three to compile_temporal_fold.
preflight_training forwards primary admission through both Fold and TemporalFold nested validators; calibration forwards it through both preflight and converted-row logistic fitting.
admit_measurement_fit validates actual retained population/cut, stores scope/policy/admission and _reopen forwards them back through the actual store admission path.
Cohort append persists scope and primary admission; unavailable source states remain separate from period checks.

Protocol register/begin/finish compare persisted scope/policy/population/cut and preserve legacy omitted-scope wire payloads; the remaining concern is planned-versus-observed completion, not the previously repaired omission downgrade.
No runtime validation or claim of successful execution is made by this review.
